conclusion.rationale: Both laws independently satisfy the full 3/3 primary + 3/3 autonomous reallocation gate. No causal superiority is claimed. V3 is promoted as the default E6 baseline because it achieves the same confirmed completion while requiring one evidence-map pass rather than adding an unconditional second review pass. V4 remains CONFIRMED_OPTIONAL for high-risk/ambiguous verification; the untested V3+V4 combination is not made mandatory.

promotion_rule.baseline: Before implementation/verification closes, map each required feature and hard gate to the exact evidence that will prove it; use that map as the checklist and close only when every row is PASS or truthful BOUNDARY.
promotion_rule.optional_high_risk: For high-risk, ambiguous, safety/authority-sensitive, or externally brittle work, run a separate second acceptance pass from the original owned contract without relying on the implementation summary; repair any miss before durable RETURN.
promotion_rule.no_combination_claim: V3+V4 together was not independently tested as a combined mandatory law.
